verses: I also saw the soul of a woman who ever licked a hot oven with her tongue, and ever burnt her own hand under the oven.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by this body, whose soul suffers so severe a punishment?'

Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This is the soul of that wicked woman who, in the world, offered defiance to her own husband and master, and became abusive; she also acted disobediently, and did not grant cohabitation at his desire; and she stole property from her husband, and secretly formed a hoard for herself.'
